flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/adminfee/{jobs/AdminFeeJob,services/AdminFeeServiceImpl,helpers/AdminFeeHelper}, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/parameter (ParameterController), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsChangeOfProcessing/ChangeOfProcessingService. ocmsadminui pages/System (ParameterList, ParameterForm), App.tsx. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: The story asks that the admin fee amount at the Pre-Notice stage can be set by an officer (Appendix A of Annex 1A, which is not in the repo). The existing code: the daily Admin Fee job reads parameter AFO/NPA (fee amount) and FOD/NPA (days since the offence date) from ocms_parameter, which the officer can edit on System > Parameter, and then sets administration_fee and amount_payable. Gap: the job only touches foreign vehicle notices (vehicle_registration_type F) that are PS-FOR, unpaid and still have a zero fee; the NPA stage is not checked. Whether Appendix A only lists a fee for foreign vehicles: cannot verify from repo, so coverage of other notice types is not proven. The value is not validated as a number; an empty or wrong value stops the job with an error. The sheet status 'Built - Has gap' matches this finding. Related tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-122 (fee not charged after 90 days, Closed/Prod deployed) and OCMS-DF-2026-170 (wrong $15 fee on non-RR3/DR3 notices, Closed); because the 170 fix writes administration_fee = 0 on stage changes other than RR3/DR3, the pre-notice fee can be wiped when the stage is changed and is charged again on the next job run [Medium confidence, not tested]. Real AFO/FOD values on the server: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Can be claimed for the AFO/FOD configuration through the Parameter page and the daily job that applies it to foreign vehicles. Coverage for other notice types and the content of Appendix A need URA confirmation; do not claim it fully before that

steps.step: The pre-notice admin fee amount (AFO/NPA) and its number of days (FOD/NPA) are stored as parameters and the officer can change them on the Parameter page
steps.detail: The System > Parameter page (App.tsx:375-396) lists all ocms_parameter rows (POST /parameterlist, ParameterController.java:81-88) and allows editing the description and value fields through POST /parameterpatch/{id1}/{id2} (ParameterController.java:90-118; form ParameterForm.tsx:154-175). The job reads rows FOD/NPA (days) and AFO/NPA (fee amount) through getFodDays and getAfoAmount (AdminFeeHelper.java:78-121). Function OCMS_SYSTEM_PARAMETER is mapped in api-authorization.properties:166-167; which roles hold it: cannot verify from repo. Note: the value is only required, with no number or range check (ValidParameter.ts:44-46). No seed of the initial values was found in the repo; the fee amount in Appendix A: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The daily Admin Fee job reads that configuration on every run and stops with an error if it is missing or invalid
steps.detail: processAdminFees reads FOD and AFO on every run, without a cache (AdminFeeServiceImpl.java:82-100). If either is missing or not a number the job returns failure with the message 'FOD parameter not found or invalid in database' or 'AFO parameter not found or invalid in database' and changes no notice (AdminFeeServiceImpl.java:82-100; AdminFeeHelper.java:78-121); the error notification is only written to the log because the email integration is still a TODO (AdminFeeHelper.java:498-514). The job is called in executeDayEndJobs (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:122, not commented out) and the day-end scheduler is enabled=true in prod, schedule 00:15 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62; job name at line 79). Real server value: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The admin fee is charged on notices at the Pre-Notice stage as in Appendix A (for all notices that qualify)
steps.detail: queryEligibleNotices only selects notices with vehicle_registration_type = 'F', suspension_type = 'PS' and epr_reason_of_suspension = 'FOR', unpaid (amount_paid 0 or NULL), administration_fee 0 or NULL, and notice date + FOD days <= today (AdminFeeHelper.java:153-172). The NPA stage is not checked, and other notice types or vehicle types are not covered. A notice with an active TS is not selected because suspension_type must be PS, so the fee waits until the TS revives (AdminFeeHelper.java:128-131, ticket OCMS-DF-2026-122, Closed). Whether Appendix A of Annex 1A only governs foreign vehicles: cannot verify from repo (the document is not in the repo).

steps.step: The configured fee is recorded on the notice, the amount payable is recalculated and passed on to the internet database
steps.detail: batchUpdateAdminFee runs one joined UPDATE: administration_fee = AFO amount, amount_payable = composition_amount + fee, is_sync = 'N' (AdminFeeHelper.java:258-267); notices without composition_amount are skipped. The amount_payable value is then read back and pushed straight to eVON in the internet database; a push failure is not fatal because is_sync = 'N' lets the sync job repair it (AdminFeeHelper.java:275-288, 332-340). Note: the OCMS-DF-2026-170 fix writes administration_fee = 0 when the stage changes to anything other than RR3/DR3 (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1157-1167; ToppanUploadHelper.java:1411), so the pre-notice fee is likely wiped if the notice stage is changed and is charged again on the next job run while the notice is still PS-FOR [Medium confidence, not tested].
